basic_details.short_information: Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), a unit of Indian Railways, has released Employment Notice No. GMA/Rectt.&MPP/Sports Quota/2026-2027 dated 20-07-2026, inviting applications from eligible Indian National sportspersons for recruitment against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement and Talent Scouting) at CLW, Chittaranjan (West Bengal). A total of 25 vacancies are notified across Level-1, Level-2 and Level-5/4 posts, spanning 15 sports discipline/event categories including Archery, Badminton, Basketball, Football, Golf, Gymnastics, Swimming and Shooting.

application_fee.details: The examination fee must be deposited through an Indian Postal Order (IPO) or Bank Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of "PFA, Chittaranjan Locomotive Works," payable at Chittaranjan. selection_process: Selection is based on performance in Sports Trials
assessed and finalized by a nominated Selection Committee. Sports achievements of the current and previous 2 years (2024-2025
2025-2026 & 2026-2027) are considered as per Para 4.2 of RBE No.189(B)/2010; only achievements on or after 01-04-2024 are counted
based on the concluding day of the championship. In the event that suitable candidates with the required sports achievements are not available for Level-5 posts as notified
candidates may also be considered in lower Group C categories to the extent of the notified posts
subject to overall suitability in the discipline.

The venue and date of Trials and Interview/Certificate Verification will be intimated to eligible candidates; candidates are advised to check the CLW official website regularly. Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for:
Trial of Sports Achievements - 40 marks (minimum 25 must be secured to be declared "FIT") Assessment of Sports Achievements
etc. - 50 marks maximum Educational Qualification - 10 marks
Minimum aggregate marks required (including a minimum of 25 marks in Trial) are 70 for Level-5/4
as per RBE No.141/2018. There is no relaxation or reservation of any kind for any community - selection is purely merit-based on the performances described above.
how_to_apply: CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 does not use an online application portal. Eligible candidates must apply offline as follows:
Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure 'A'), along with other relevant annexures, on good-quality A4-size white paper, after carefully reading the Employment Notice.
Fill all columns of the application in your own handwriting, in English or Hindi, using a blue or black ball-point pen.
Write the sample declaration statement in your own handwriting in the space provided; applications without the written declaration will be rejected.

Affix one recent (taken within one month) colour passport-size photograph with a white background, without a cap or coloured glasses; send 2 signed photographs with the application and keep at least 5 more for future use.
Enclose legible photocopies of all certificates - Educational Qualification, Age, Caste Certificate, and Sports Achievement certificates - attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested.
Enclose the applicable application fee; applications without the fee or with incomplete columns will be rejected.
Clearly indicate the Specific Category No., Sports Discipline and Event/Position as given in the vacancy table.
Write on the top of the envelope: "APPLICATION AGAINST SPORTS QUOTA (OPEN ADVERTISEMENT & TALENT SCOUTING) RECRUITMENT FOR THE YEAR 2026-2027."

Send the application by post, or drop it in the Drop Box at the Dy.GM's Office/CLW, so that it reaches the address below on or before the closing date and time. Railway Administration is not responsible for postal delay; late applications will be summarily rejected.
Serving Government employees should send their applications through proper channel, i.e., through their office.
Postal Address: Chief Personnel Officer, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, P.O. Chittaranjan, District-Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal, Pin Code-713331.
Candidates may download the recruitment notification and application form from the CLW website: www.clw.indianrailways.gov.in.
important_instructions: Eligible applicants will be issued Call Letters through the website, email and the mobile number provided, within 20 days from the closing date; candidates must report with the Call Letter. SC/ST candidates are eligible for free rail travel in Second Class for attending the Sports Trial/Interview. Selected candidates must pass the requisite medical fitness standard prior to appointment. Candidates appointed as Junior Clerk-cum-Typist (Group C) must acquire typing proficiency of 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within 4 years of appointment; until then, the appointment remains provisional. The decision of CLW Administration in all matters relating to this recruitment is final. The list of applications rejected will be published on www.clw.indianrailways.gov.in; no other rejection intimation will be sent. The recruitment process is purely merit-based; canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. CLW, Chittaranjan, reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time, without assigning reasons. The date, time and venue of the Sports Trial will be fixed by the Railway Administration and intimated on the CLW official website; the administration is not responsible for late or non-receipt of intimation. Candidates should report for the Trial on the date mentioned on the website, even if the call letter is not received. Applications may be treated as invalid for reasons including: receipt after the closing date/time; incorrect or incomplete format; lack of required qualifications on the date of applying; being underage/overage as stipulated; multiple applications by the same candidate; missing photo, declaration, or signature; missing enclosures; being on a debarred list; or submitting participation/medal certificates on letterheads (which are not considered). CLW has not appointed any agents or coaching centres to act on its behalf for this recruitment; candidates should report any false claims by unscrupulous persons/agencies to the Chief Personnel Officer or the SDGM & Chief Vigilance Officer, CLW. Any dispute regarding this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court of Calcutta.

faq.question: Q1. What is CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), Indian Railways, to fill 25 Group C posts under Sports Quota (Open Advertisement and Talent Scouting) for the 2026-2027 cycle, across 15 sports discipline/event categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 25 vacancies are notified: 2 at Level-5/4, 8 at Level-2, and 15 at Level-1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date is 20-08-2026 up to 17:00 hrs for most candidates, extended to 31-08-2026 up to 17:00 hrs for candidates residing in specified North-Eastern and hill states/UTs and for candidates residing abroad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the pay level applied for: Graduate in any discipline for Level-5/4; 12th/10+2 or equivalent (or Matriculation with apprenticeship/diploma) for Level-2; and 10th/Secondary or ITI/NAC for Level-1.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 25 years as on 01-01-2026, with no age relaxation for any category, including SC/ST/OBC/PwBD.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.250/- for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Women/Minorities/EBC candidates, and Rs.500/- for all other candidates, payable via IPO or Bank DD in favour of "PFA, Chittaranjan Locomotive Works."

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Candidates must fill the prescribed Annexure 'A' application form by hand, attach the required documents and fee, and send it by post (or drop it in the Drop Box at CLW) to the Chief Personnel Officer, CLW, Chittaranjan, before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Sports Trial (40 marks), Assessment of Sports Achievements (50 marks), and Educational Qualification (10 marks), with a minimum aggregate of 70/65/60 marks required for Level-5/4, Level-2 and Level-1 posts respectively. Selection is purely merit-based, with no reservation or relaxation for any community.
